title: Onboard aphelion-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Menon
description: Add Aphelion-13B v1.0 metadata and performance profiles and enable changelog/release-notes automation for new model onboarding. Motivation: customers requested a performant 13B variant with lower latency on common seq lengths; this onboarding bundles verified perf profiles, model metadata (quantization recommendations, supported variants), and wiring into the existing changelog generator so releases are auto-updated. Changes include new registry metadata YAML for aphelion-13b v1.0, perf profile JSON with latency/throughput baselines and recommended kernel/quantization settings, unit tests validating profile schema, and CI workflow updates to run model-resources smoke tests and generate changelog entries. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata and manifest - [x] Generate perf profiles from lab harness - [x] Add automated changelog entry generation - [x] Add unit/integration tests for profiles - [x] Docs stub in registry README - [x] Get approvals from perf and model teams
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial metadata and manifest; add perf profiles + lab-derived baselines; CI/workflow to run changelog generator; tests and docs updates.
review_comments: Lucas Kim (reviewer): Can you include the hardware spec used for perf baselines? The numbers look good but we need clarity on GPU type and sequence lengths. Author: Added GPU spec and seq lengths to perf profile JSON and docs (aphelion profile includes A100-80GB, seqs [64,256,1024]).
Anya Rodriguez (reviewer): Nit: manifest schema version bump needed. Author: bumped to schema v2 and updated tests.
Marco Li (approver): Verified smoke-tests locally; perf numbers reproduce within 5% of harness runs. Approved.
CI Bot: Integration test failed on first run (smoke-tests timeout). Author: increased timeout and added retry wrapper; reran CI which passed.
ci_checks: Perf runner: pass (benchmarks run in harness)
merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Priya Menon on 2026-02-28 (squash and merge). Merge commit: abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12
release_notes: Added Aphelion-13B v1.0 to model registry with validated performance profiles and automated changelog entry. Notes: - Baseline latency and throughput metrics for A100-80GB (seq=64/256/1024) included. - Recommended quantization: q4_0 for latency-sensitive workloads; q8_0 for higher quality/throughput tradeoffs. - Registry manifest includes supported variants and tokenizer config.
notes: This PR also enables the changelog generator to pick up new model metadata files under registry/metadata/*.yaml. The automation creates a draft release notes entry in the repo and adds a link to the release dashboard.
